Package index

Package Overview

stablr stablr-package
stablr: Sparse and Reliable Biomarker Discovery in R

Getting started

The one-stop-shop entry point for new users — a data.frame in, a plain-language selection out.

stabl()
STABL Stability Selection (Beginner Interface)
print(<stabl>)
Print a Fitted STABL Object (Beginner Style)
summary(<stabl>)
Summarize a Fitted STABL Object (Beginner Style)
plot(<stabl>)
Plot Stability Paths for a Fitted STABL Object (Beginner Style)

Core STABL Engine

Fit single-matrix STABL selectors and compute FDP+ thresholds (expert interface).

stabl_fit() print(<stabl_fit>)
Fit STABL (Stability-Penalized Feature Selection)
auto_lambda_grid()
Build a Data-Driven Lambda Grid
compute_fdp_plus()
Compute FDP+ (False Discovery Proportion Upper Bound)

Environment Stability

ICP-inspired transportability workflow across environments (batches, cohorts, sites); promoted with a documented scope after the WS-5 transportability benchmark (min-aggregation is the calibrated read).

stabl_environment_stability()
Environment-Stability Workflow: Reliable and Transportable Feature Sets
get_min_scores()
Get Minimum-Across-Environment Stability Scores
print(<stabl_env_stability>)
Print an Environment-Stability Analysis

Accessors

get_support()
Get the Feature Selection Mask from a Fitted STABL Object
get_feature_names()
Get the Names of Selected Features from a Fitted STABL Object
get_fdrs()
Get FDP+ Diagnostic Estimates Across the Swept Thresholds
transform_stabl()
Transform New Data to the Selected STABL Feature Set
get_stabl_scores()
Get the Full Stability Score Matrix from a Fitted STABL Object
get_importances()
Get Per-Feature Importance Scores (Maximum Stability Score)
get_lambda_grid()
Get the Fitted Lambda Grid
get_cooperative_features()
Get Cooperative-Fusion Selected Features
get_cooperative_diagnostics()
Get Cooperative-Fusion Tuning Diagnostics

Multi-Omic Workflows

stabl_multiomic_train_validate() print(<stabl_multiomic_fit>)
Multi-Omic STABL Train/Validation Workflow
stabl_multiomic_cv() print(<stabl_multiomic_cv>)
Multi-Omic STABL Cross-Validation Workflow
stabl_multiomic_nested_cv() print(<stabl_multiomic_nested_cv>)
Multi-Omic STABL Nested Cross-Validation
stabl_multiomic_stacked()
Stacked Generalization Over Per-Omic Predictions
stabl_multiomic_study_diagnostics()
Per-Study Batch Diagnostics for Multi-Omic STABL Inputs
stabl_multiomic_scheme_comparison()
Compare Sample-I.I.D. and Study-Disjoint Nested CV
stabl_multiomic_selection_stability()
Selection Stability Across Study-Disjoint Folds
load_ool_data()
Load the Onset of Labor example dataset

Analysis Workflow

Explicit exploratory/validated analysis with canonical evidence tables and fold-safe preprocessing.

stabl_analyze() print(<stabl_analysis>) summary(<stabl_analysis>)
STABL analysis with an explicit evidence mode
stabl_interpret() print(<stabl_interpretation>)
Interpret a fitted STABL selection
summary(<stabl_interpretation>)
Summarise a STABL Interpretation
plot(<stabl_interpretation>)
Plot Selected-Feature Stability
stabl_preprocess_fit()
Fit a fold-safe preprocessing transform on training data
stabl_preprocess_apply()
Apply a fitted preprocessing transform

Reliability and Final Models

Post-selection reliability diagnostics, outcome-null validation, cohort replication, and portable final models (Phase 13; see the stablr-reliability article for a guided tour).

stabl_diagnose()
Diagnose selection reliability of a fitted STABL object
print(<stabl_diagnostics>)
Print STABL Selection Diagnostics
plot(<stabl_diagnostics>)
Plot STABL selection diagnostics
stabl_null_check()
Outcome-Null Calibration Check for STABL
print(<stabl_null_validation>)
Print an Outcome-Null Validation Summary
plot(<stabl_null_validation>)
Plot Outcome-Null Validation Results
stabl_replication_profile()
Cohort Replication and Heterogeneity Profile
print(<stabl_replication_profile>)
Print a Cohort Replication Profile
stabl_finalize() predict(<stabl_predictor>) print(<stabl_predictor>)
Finalize a STABL selection into a portable predictive model

Visualization

plot_stabl_path()
Plot the STABL Stability Path
plot_fdr_graph()
Plot the FDP+ Diagnostic Curve

Plot a fitted stabl_fit

S3 plot method for fitted STABL objects (stability path and FDP+ graph).

plot(<stabl_fit>)
Plot a Fitted stabl_fit Object

Summarise a fitted stabl_fit

S3 summary and print methods for fitted STABL objects.

summary(<stabl_fit>) print(<summary.stabl_fit>)
Summarize a Fitted stabl_fit Object

Export

Single entry point for persisting results — CSV tables only (what = “csv”) or the full results bundle (default what = “all”).

save_stabl_results()
Save STABL Results to Disk

Selection Similarity Metrics

Reproducibility of selected feature sets across runs — one pairwise verb with three methods, plus a one-number summary. The eight 0.3.0 similarity names were removed ahead of 1.0.0.

stabl_similarity()
Similarity Between Feature Sets
stabl_similarity_summary()
Summary Statistic of Pairwise Similarity Values
